newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian air traffic normal as dispute resolved.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian air traffic normal as dispute resolved.

text.p: Bulgaria's air traffic has returned to normal following the resolution of a wage dispute between air traffic controllers and employers, a senior official said on Wednesday.
He said four controllers were fired for failing to turn up for work, including the chief of the Bulgarian association of air traffic controllers Stefan Raichev, who headed the protests.
"Everything is over. The situation is normal. Traffic is normal, too," said the official, who declined to be named.
Some controllers had demanded an increase in their monthly wage from $230 to some $1,000 and the resignation of the air traffic service's management.
Some 40 air controllers were fired last week as they refused to return to work despite a local court ruling that a strike planned for September 3 was illegal. They have since been reinstated.
